name: rebalance-spacing-15m-current-config
rationale: Lead #2 of the 2026-10-19 report. rebalance-spacing-15m was the strongest pure-config improvement at the diagnostic capitals on that run (Sharpe -21.2 vs -31.4 at 500k, -16.7 vs -24.6 at 5M) and a near-miss at 50k (Sharpe +2.33, rejected on +0.48 pp drawdown), but it ran with the stale zone 0.2/0.8. This is experiments/baseline-config.json exactly, with only rebalance_interval_secs raised from 60 to 900, so the delta measures the spacing alone. Also a cost-side hypothesis: the baseline has lost to its static mix at 500k for 17 consecutive runs, and the warning rule requires one turnover-targeting hypothesis.
